harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the C10 native-object-recheck route end to end: build a real mumei.native-bundle/v1 from an atom that returns 0 without writing stdout or stderr, run `python -m agent native-object-recheck` so one invocation reproduces the pinned artifacts and checks object symbols, direct call edges, and linked placements, then show a wrong build ID produces no claimed outcome. The route does not claim full object translation validation.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: scenarios/native_object_recheck/src/main.mm (the bounded native profile atom main() -> i64 requires: true).
Step 1 runs `native-bundle build`, verifies the record pins exit status 0 plus the SHA-256 of empty stdout and stderr, and records sha256(native-bundle.json) as the trusted-channel build ID.

Step 2 runs the declared `native-object-recheck` route and asserts the matching object symbol, call-edge, and linked-placement checks, object_correspondence_schema, and the remaining object translation check.
Step 3 reruns the route with a wrong build ID and asserts no claimed outcome, full C02/object checks_not_performed, and normalized exit_code 1.

name: Declared Native Object Recheck (native-object-recheck)
description: C10 Option B bounded object correspondence demo: the declared `native-object-recheck` route runs `native-bundle recheck-object --json` as one attempt — `object_recheck: corresponds` plus `artifact_semantics`, `claim_truth`, `object_call_edge_correspondence`, `object_link_correspondence`, and `object_symbol_correspondence`; the matching Core descriptor is named, while full `object_translation_correspondence` remains unperformed and a wrong build ID leaves the full C02/object family unperformed.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Show the declared native-object-recheck route executing a real bundle's bounded symbol-surface, direct-call-edge, and linked-placement correspondence checks after artifact reproduction, emitting the matching Core schema, then refusing to claim an outcome for a wrong build ID without claiming full object translation validation.
success_criteria: report.json carries mumei.native-object-recheck-report/v1 with object_recheck == 'corresponds', discharged_checks == ['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'object_call_edge_correspondence', 'object_link_correspondence', 'object_symbol_correspondence'], checks_not_performed == ['file_identity', 'freshness', 'object_translation_correspondence', 'producer_authenticity', 'semantic_correspondence'], object_correspondence_schema == 'mumei.object-symbol-correspondence/v1', and expected_build_id equal to sha256(native-bundle.json)

wrong_report.json carries no object_recheck, object_correspondence_schema or discharged_checks, checks_not_performed == ['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'file_identity', 'freshness', 'object_call_edge_correspondence', 'object_link_correspondence', 'object_symbol_correspondence', 'object_translation_correspondence', 'producer_authenticity', 'semantic_correspondence'], no selected_result and normalized exit_code 1

steps.name: Produce a native bundle with pinned outputs
steps.command: {mumei_bin} native-bundle build {root_dir}/scenarios/native_object_recheck/src/main.mm -o {output_dir}/bundle > {output_dir}/build.log 2>&1 && python3 -c "import hashlib,json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json')); p=r['link_build']; empty=hashlib.sha256(b'').hexdigest(); assert p['expected_exit_status']==0, p; assert p['expected_stdout_sha256']==empty, p; assert p['expected_stderr_sha256']==empty, p; print(hashlib.sha256(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json','rb').read()).hexdigest())" > {output_dir}/build_id.txt; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/build.log; cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt; test $rc -eq 0
steps.artifact_contract: build_id.txt holds sha256(native-bundle.json); link_build pins exit status 0 and the empty stdout/stderr digests; bundle/ holds all five declared members.
steps.verifier_gate: native-bundle build exits 0 and the complete record contains all three runtime observation pins.

steps.name: native-object-recheck reports bounded correspondence
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-object-recheck --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_object_recheck/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --output {output_dir}/report.json > {output_dir}/recheck.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/report.json; cat {output_dir}/recheck.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-object-recheck-report/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['object_recheck']=='corresponds', r; assert r['discharged_checks']==['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'object_call_edge_correspondence', 'object_link_correspondence', 'object_symbol_correspondence'], r; assert r['checks_not_performed']==['file_identity', 'freshness', 'object_translation_correspondence', 'producer_authenticity', 'semantic_correspondence'], r; assert r['object_correspondence_schema']=='mumei.object-symbol-correspondence/v1', r; assert r['expected_build_id']==open('{output_dir}/build_id.txt').read().strip(), r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None; assert 'candidate' not in r; print('native-object-recheck: bounded object symbol, call-edge, and link correspondence')"
steps.artifact_contract: report.json holds mumei.native-object-recheck-report/v1 with matching bounded object-symbol, direct-call-edge, and linked-placement checks, names the matching Core descriptor schema, and leaves object_translation_correspondence unperformed.
steps.verifier_gate: native-object-recheck exits 0; artifact reproduction and all three bounded object correspondence checks pass in one invocation.

steps.name: Wrong build ID claims no outcome
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-object-recheck --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_object_recheck/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest())") --output {output_dir}/wrong_report.json > {output_dir}/wrong.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/wrong_report.json; cat {output_dir}/wrong.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import hashlib,json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/wrong_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-object-recheck-report/v1'; assert 'object_recheck' not in r; assert 'object_correspondence_schema' not in r; assert 'discharged_checks' not in r; assert r['expected_build_id']==hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest(), r; assert r['checks_not_performed']==['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'file_identity', 'freshness', 'object_call_edge_correspondence', 'object_link_correspondence', 'object_symbol_correspondence', 'object_translation_correspondence', 'producer_authenticity', 'semantic_correspondence'], r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is None; assert r['normalized'].get('exit_code') == 1, r['normalized']; print('wrong build ID: no claimed outcome, exit 1')"
steps.artifact_contract: wrong_report.json holds no object_recheck, object_correspondence_schema or discharged_checks, full C02/object checks_not_performed, no selected_result, normalized exit_code 1, and the echoed wrong expected_build_id.
steps.verifier_gate: The mismatched build ID exits 1 — no claimed outcome.
